notes: The GPU receives PCM from the client. No audio fixture is placed in its image.
A bounded diagnostic capture of received frames is used for controls after runtime cleanup.
Native FINAL receipt and done receipt have different meanings: done includes controls and model hashing.
Server and client monotonic clocks cannot establish one-way network latency.
Modal can reschedule crashed containers. One client connection is not an absolute physical execution cap.
Temporary proxy credentials remain in memory and are deleted after the ephemeral app context exits.
